description: This file defines the LazyContextRepository class in the Drupal core plugin context namespace, implementing context repository functionality with dependency injection and context management methods.

classes.name: LazyContextRepository
classes.description: Implements a context repository that lazily loads context providers using dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a service container and context provider service IDs.

methods.name: getRuntimeContexts
methods.description: Retrieves runtime contexts for given context IDs, loading missing contexts from services.

methods.name: getAvailableContexts
methods.description: Returns all available contexts from registered context provider services.
